    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_thin_diagram

    Thin cleaving diagrams with conditions in P #

    MulBasis.not_thin_diagram: a thin diagram (a finite poset with zero relations) given by objects and morphisms of P, whose morphisms are not divisible by τ and which satisfies the arrow conditions of the local cleaving criterion in P, cannot exist when its thin category is representation-infinite.
